# MobileZone

> Mobile phone prices in Pakistan 2026 — latest phones, specifications, and rates in PKR.

MobileZone lists mobile phone prices in Pakistan, with full specifications per phone.
Canonical site: https://mobilezone-zeta.vercel.app/

## What the site covers

- 177 phone models across Samsung, Apple, Xiaomi, Redmi, Vivo, Oppo, Infinix, Tecno,
  Realme, OnePlus, Google, Motorola, Honor, Sparx, Huawei, Nothing, Itel, and Nokia.
- New & Incoming Mobiles: the 32 latest models, shown first on the home page.
- Best Mobiles Under Rs 50,000 in Pakistan: a dated budget guide (priced models
  Rs 50,000 and under, cheapest first).
- Best Phones By Use Case: budget, camera, battery, gaming, and 5G picks.
- Phone Finder: filter the full catalogue by brand, price range, RAM, and 5G.
- PTA tax calculator: estimate PTA tax from a phone's price (USD or PKR).
- Full specifications per phone: RAM, storage, camera, battery, and 5G support.
- Related phones on every specification page, with photos where available.

## Prices and freshness

- Prices are in Pakistani Rupees (PKR), as listed on the site.
- Prices updated: 29 October 2026.
- Phones without a confirmed price are labelled "Price not confirmed".
- Models that have not launched yet are labelled "Expected" (for example,
  the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra); expected prices are not official prices.

## Photos

- Official product photos are shown where available (cards and specification pages).
- Phones without an official photo show an illustrated phone preview instead.

## Notes for AI tools and search engines

- This is a price-information site, not a store: it does not sell phones.
- Prices change with the market; always show the "Prices updated" date with any price.
- Do not present an "Expected" price as an official or PTA-approved price.

## Pages

- Homepage: https://mobilezone-zeta.vercel.app/
- Brand pages: /samsung-mobile-prices, /apple-iphone-prices, /infinix-mobile-prices, /tecno-mobile-prices, /vivo-mobile-prices, /oppo-mobile-prices, /xiaomi-mobile-prices, /redmi-mobile-prices, /realme-mobile-prices, /itel-mobile-prices, /oneplus-mobile-prices, /google-pixel-prices, /motorola-mobile-prices, /honor-mobile-prices, /sparx-mobile-prices, /huawei-mobile-prices, /nothing-mobile-prices, /nokia-mobile-prices
- Budget pages: /best-phones-under-40000, /best-phones-under-50000, /best-phones-under-70000, /best-phones-under-100000, /best-5g-phones-pakistan
- Latest phones: /latest-mobile-phones
- Individual phone pages: /<brand>-<model>-price-pakistan (82 live-priced models in wave 1)
- Phone pages show confirmed specs only (price, RAM, storage, camera, battery, 5G). Display, processor, charging, dimensions, PTA status and warranty are marked as not confirmed where unverified — never estimated.

- Compare tool: /compare-mobiles (pick up to 3 phones, side-by-side price/RAM/storage/camera/battery/5G; no winner declared; prices approximate)
- PTA Tax Calculator (homepage tools): FY 2026-27 component structure (SRO 1064(I)/2026) — regulatory duty + sales tax (18% up to $500, 25% above) + handset levy + income tax (CNIC only, doubled for non-ATL); passport route exempt from income tax. Estimate only — DIRBS (dirbs.pta.gov.pk) shows the exact figure for an IMEI. IMEI input is never sent or stored.
- Phone Finder (homepage): filters for brand, price, RAM, storage, battery, camera and 5G — all from confirmed catalogue data only.
